A.name: All features (end of session)
A.why: Uses every column. PageValues is computed by Google Analytics from revenue of sessions that passed through the same pages, so it may partly encode the outcome. Treated as an optimistic upper bound.

B.name: Without PageValues (main setting)
B.why: Drops the revenue-derived PageValues. Everything left describes what the visitor did (pages, time, rates, context). This is the setting our main claim rests on.
